$comment: Scoop manifest stub for autogpt-local-executor.
Drop into a Scoop bucket (e.g. Significant-Gravitas/scoop-bucket) at
bucket/autogpt-local-executor.json. Users then install with:
scoop bucket add autogpt https://github.com/Significant-Gravitas/scoop-bucket
scoop install autogpt/autogpt-local-executor
Not run yet: `url` and `hash` are placeholders until a wheel is on PyPI, so this
has never been installed from a real bucket. Install from it on a Windows
machine before it goes to the bucket (docs/RELEASE_RUNBOOK.md, the smoke test).
The installer script installs the wheel Scoop itself downloaded and checked
against `hash` ($dir\$fname; Scoop sets $dir and $fname for an installer
script, and no $url) into a virtual environment, and `bin` is that
environment's launcher, which runs its own Python. pip fetches the package's
dependencies from PyPI: only the wheel is covered by `hash`.
Post-PyPI-publish checklist:
1. Bump `version` to the new tag.
2. Replace `url` with the wheel URL on PyPI.
3. Replace `hash` with the wheel's sha256 (Get-FileHash on Windows).
4. Check the autoupdate stanza with Scoop's `bin\checkver.ps1` (there is no
`scoop checkver` command): in a copy of this manifest set `version` back
to an earlier one, run `.\bin\checkver.ps1 autogpt-local-executor <the
copy's folder> -u` from Scoop's own folder or a bucket's, and see that it
writes this release's `url` and `hash`.
5. Install from the manifest on a Windows machine and run `autogpt-shim --version`.
description: EXPERIMENTAL local PC shim for the AutoGPT hosted platform.
notes: EXPERIMENTAL: gives the AutoGPT hosted platform code execution access
to this machine. Read docs/SECURITY.md before running it.
One-time setup, in your own prompt (it takes no elevated prompt):
`install` writes a Task Scheduler task for your account and prints the
schtasks command that registers it: run the command it prints.
Stop the service and remove the autostart entry with:

script: if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Could not make the virtual environment.' }
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Could not install the wheel.' }
